_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRACK-PROMPT VERSION TRUTH. Every surface that names a track-prompt version reads THIS file. Four version strings were live at once (v0.10, v0.18, v1.0.2, v2.0.2) because each surface carried its own literal; that is how a version number came to name two different documents.
injection_note: Injected ONCE per session, not per turn. Measured 2026-08-03: cache read is 82.3% of spend and scales with per-call context, so a 54610-byte body on a per-turn hook would be the single most expensive line in the harness. The per-turn hook carries only what genuinely lapses: the buffer write and the computed statusline.

provenance.rule: The hook may ONLY inject bytes that exist as a versioned file in track-prompt-lab prompts/, and must declare which version. Authoring a track prompt inside the harness is forbidden (spec-track-prompt-promotion-chain-v1).

retired_versions._note: RETIRED. Never reuse — each is already bound to a different document, so any measurement keyed to one is unattributable.
